crossRefs.note: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.
Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered…
Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate…

translations.web: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
translations.bsb: Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
translations.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
translations.asv: And when even was now come, because it was the Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
